capabilities: Create today's daily note by copying yesterday's at a scheduled time
Skip creation when today's note exists or yesterday's is missing
Copy note body and frontmatter verbatim
Trigger creation manually via command or ribbon icon
Configure daily note folder, date format, creation time and auto-open
extras: README documents limits in detail: it only runs while Obsidian is open, missed runs are caught up at startup, mobile background execution is not guaranteed, and running it on several devices at once can cause sync conflicts. Documentation is also provided in Japanese.
motivation: The README says it saves users from copying yesterday's note by hand every morning when they keep tasks, habits or context in their daily note.
problem: Obsidian creates an empty daily note by default, so keeping a running list of tasks or context means copying yesterday's note by hand every day.
summary: Scheduler that creates today's daily note at a set time by copying yesterday's daily note verbatim.
